quality_boundary: Sixth comprehensive plan (2018-2027, three-section structure), budget enactment and settlement certification confirmed on official council vote-result PDFs (individual vote dates are not printed and are not recorded), and settlement totals kept at published thousand-yen precision without collapsing proposed, enacted, supplementary, or settlement states.
